findings.title: Multiline log reader size_t underflow yields strncpy stack overflow.
findings.description: read_multiline accumulates lines into stack buffer[OS_MAXSTR+1] with strncpy(buffer+buffer_size, str, OS_MAXSTR-buffer_size-2) after inserting a space. When log_format is multiline:N with N>=3, two maximum-length lines leave buffer_size near OS_MAXSTR; the third line wraps the remaining-length expression to a huge size_t and overflows the stack buffer. Distinct from the already-reported read_snortfull signed f_msg_size underflow.
findings.impact: Crash or likely code execution in ossec-logcollector whenever multiline localfile monitoring (N>=3) is enabled and an attacker can write the monitored file.
findings.attack_path:
1. Operator configures <localfile><log_format>multiline:3</log_format><location>PATH</location></localfile>.
2. Attacker writes PATH with three lines each >= ~5887 bytes (fgets limit OS_MAXSTR-OS_LOG_HEADER) without early newlines.
3. On the third accumulation, OS_MAXSTR-buffer_size-2 underflows; strncpy writes past buffer.
4. logcollector crashes or stack corruption runs as the logcollector user.
findings.remediation: Track remaining capacity as size_t; abort/truncate when buffer_size+1+strlen(str) >= OS_MAXSTR; always force a trailing NUL after strncpy.
findings.poc_video_notes: Local C replica of the accumulation loop showed L3 n=2^64-1 after two max lines; ASan aborted on a bounded OOB write at buffer+6143. No live logcollector was crashed in this at-rest environment.

findings.title: doDiff joins unsanitized hostname into DIFF_DIR path (ASL Host /), distinct from UAF and ossecalert.
findings.description: doDiff snprintfs DIFF_DIR/hostname/sigid/last-entry and _add2last mkdir/fopen/fwrite without rejecting '/' or '..'. hostname_map also allows '/'. Traditional syslog 'host ossec: output:…' does NOT reach stock rule 533 because CleanMSG strips ossec as program_name and breaks decoder ^ossec: . Reachable via OSX ASL framing: [Message ossec: output: 'netstat -tan': …] keeps lf->log for rules 530/533 while [Host ../../etc/shared] sets lf->hostname with no hostname_map filter. Distinct from doDiff last_events UAF and from ossecalert AGENTINFO_DIR fopen. Secure-agent paren branch only uses alphanumeric OS_IsValidName.
findings.impact: When syslog remoted (or ASL localfile) is enabled, attacker-controlled create/overwrite of …/<sigid>/last-entry under attacker-influenced directories inside the analysisd chroot (e.g. etc/shared/533/last-entry) as ossecr.
findings.attack_path:
1. Operator enables remoted <connection>syslog</connection> (or monitors ASL logs).
2. Attacker sends two ASL-shaped events with Message ossec: output: 'netstat -tan': A then B, and Host ../../etc/shared.
3. analysisd decodes as ossec; rule 533 check_diff calls doDiff.
4. _add2last creates etc/shared/533/last-entry (in chroot) with attacker log bytes.
findings.remediation: Sanitize or hash hostname before path join; reject '/', '..', and non-allowlisted bytes. Keep check_diff storage under a fixed per-agent-id directory.
findings.poc_video_notes: Validated path normalization queue/diff/../../etc/shared/533/last-entry -> etc/shared/533/last-entry with local mkdir/fwrite replica. Confirmed traditional syslog same-line host+ossec: fails decoder after program_name strip. No live analysisd/syslog lab in this at-rest scan.
